title: rothia
intro: Rothia, commonly known as the Rothia plant, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of Rothia include its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rothia include its use as a natural remedy for treating digestive issues, such as irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), as well as its potential to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Rothia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
